foundry.prompt: Create a finished premium hand-painted semi-realistic BACKGROUND PANORAMA for an original 2D side-scrolling game named Rustbelt Run. This is the next district of the SAME overgrown industrial valley as the reference: a flooded service canal leading into an old copper-and-brick foundry. Match the reference painting's tactile detail, moss, rich green foliage, believable Victorian industrial architecture, distant mountain silhouettes and luminous atmosphere. New composition, NOT a recoloring of the same factory. Widescreen panoramic canvas. Left side: cool blue-green mist over a canal, an old stone bridge, trees, mossy retaining walls and quiet wooden lock gates. Middle distance: tall brick engine houses, elegant iron trusses, rusted pipes, water towers and rail gantries. Right side: an imposing foundry with several arched openings glowing amber from within, warm window lights reflected across the canal, a tall brick chimney, ivy and small trees around the foundations. Dusk-like warm copper light meeting cool teal haze, atmospheric depth, golden cloud edges, subtle hints of steam. Keep buildings clearly in the background; do not add any foreground playable walkways or platforms. Lower fifth of the painting is mostly canal water and shadowed greenery. Maintain enough calm, low-contrast detail in the middle to let bright gameplay objects read clearly. No characters, text, logos, UI, borders or grids. The scene should feel a distinct destination while belonging to the same valley. Output at the widest landscape aspect ratio available.

patrol_bot.prompt: Create ONE single finished production 2D game sprite on a truly TRANSPARENT background. An original small PATROL MAINTENANCE ROBOT for a richly painted side-scrolling fox-mechanic adventure. The robot is about knee-high to an upright fox, boxy but appealing, grounded believable industrial design: worn dark petrol-teal painted metal hull with chipped copper edges, warm brass rivets, a small yellow-ochre warning plate, two visible small rubber-tired wheels or a low tracked undercarriage, one rounded square amber eye-lens facing RIGHT, a few little tools and vents. Silhouette should be clearly mechanical with a flat SAFE STOMPABLE TOP, no spikes, no weapons. A short capped exhaust at rear. Strict side-view profile facing right with the entire robot visible. Hand-painted semi-realistic textured finish, crisp edge silhouette, warm upper-right rim light with cool shadow, consistent with the supplied valley painting. Premium 2D adventure game art, cute but slightly grumpy. Do not show more than one robot. Transparent background, no ground plane, no shadow outside the sprite, no environment, no text, no border, no labels. Plenty of transparent padding. It will be scaled to roughly 40x35 gameplay pixels, so avoid excessively thin details.
